# Gemini 保姆级实战攻略
> AI 酋长 Andy 编写的独立免费 Gemini 2026 中文实战课程。非 Google 官方。

Version: 1.0.0, verified 2026-11-23

18 lessons: Gemini App, prompting, files, Canvas, Deep Research, Workspace, NotebookLM, content, data, hiring, startup, Skills, Gemini CLI, AI Studio/API, multimodal, delivery, safety, 7/30-day training.
32 task prompts, five role-based learning paths, 7-day and 30-day training.
Official references and limitations are included in course data and each module.
No user data collection on the site. Checkboxes store progress in browser localStorage only.
